source: 780 Primary Job

source: Lumian listened to the bartender recount the rivalries and grudges of the Pirate Admirals while the pirates behind him grew increasingly restless.
target: Lumian auscultavit tabernarium, qui certamina atque rancores Admiralium Piratarum enarrabat, dum piratae post eum paulatim inquietiores fiebant.

source: They were all hoping someone would make the first move, either by shooting or stabbing the arrogant adventurer, so they could all rush him at once.
target: Omnes sperabant aliquem primum agere, sive telum iaciendo sive cultrum inferendo superbum adventorem, ut omnes simul in eum impetum facerent.

source: But the threat of those crimson‐white fireballs deterred them.
target: At minas illorum globorum ignium rubro‐alborum eos deterruerunt.

source: They looked at each other, but no one dared cross the chair Lumian had designated.
target: Invicem spectabant, sed nemo ausus est transire sellam quam Lumian destinaverat.

source: They figured anyone this brazen had to be pretty strong, and the Carnival Bar was low‐tier, with no high‐profile pirates around.
target: Rati erant quemquam tam audacem esse debere validum, et taberna Carnivalis erat humilis, sine piratis claris circumstantibus.

source: They could only hope those who had left would return with someone more formidable.
target: Sperabant tantum eos qui discesserant redire cum aliquo formidabiliore.

source: After about ten minutes, one of the pirates who had left pushed open the heavy wooden door.
target: Post circiter decem minutas, unus e piratis qui discesserant, ostium grave ligneum aperuit.

source: Behind him was a middle‐aged man wearing a tricorne hat and dressed in dark blue.
target: Post eum erat vir aetate mediocris, galeam tricorna indutus et in veste caerulea obscura gerens.

source: The pirates in the bar immediately straightened up, holding their breath.
target: Piratae in taberna statim se recti sunt, spiritum retinentes.

source: The noisy, lively atmosphere quickly returned to silence.
target: Strepitus atque animus vivus celeriter in silentium redierunt.

source: Some of them recognized the man, knowing him as Captain Flying Hadmagk of the Rosemary, a well‐known pirate just below the Pirate Admirals, active on the Five Seas for over a decade.
target: Alii virum agnoverunt, scientes eum esse Capitaneum Flying Hadmagk de Rosemary, piratam notum paulo infra Admirales Piratarum, qui per quinque maria per plus quam decem annos active operabatur.

source: The pirate who opened the door flashed a flattering smile and pointed at Lumian’s back.
target: Pirata, qui ostium aperuit, risum adflatum praebuit et digitum in dorsum Lumiani demonstravit.

source: “Captain, that’s the adventurer I mentioned!
target: “Capitane, hic est adventor quem memoravi!

source: He dared to provoke all the pirates in Banamo Port!”
target: Auso est omnes piratas Portus Banamo provocare!

source: Hadmagk, with his thick, dark hair and imposing presence, stared at Lumian’s back for a few seconds.
target: Hadmagk, cum capillis densis atque obscuris et praesentiā imponente, per paucos secundos in dorsum Lumiani aspexit.

source: He paused before asking, “How long has he been maintaining those fireballs?”
target: Intermissit antequam rogaverit: “Quamdiu illa globula ignium servat?”

source: “I don’t know.
target: “Nescio.

source: They were there when I left the bar, but he might not have kept them up the whole time,” the pirate replied.
target: Illa erant ibi, cum tabernam relicissem, sed fortasse totum tempus non servavit, respondit pirata.

source: He grabbed a young pirate sitting by the door, pointing at Lumian and growling, “How long has he been keeping those fireballs up?”
target: Rapuit iuvenem piratam, qui prope ostium sedebat, et digitum in Lumianum demonstrans rugiens, “Quamdiu illa globula ignium servat?”

source: The young pirate, a bit flustered, glanced at the old clock on the wall and stammered, “Almost… almost fifteen minutes.”
target: Iuvenis pirata, paulum turbatus, ad vetus horologium in pariete aspexit et titubans dixit: “Fere… fere quindecim minuta.”

source: Fifteen minutes?
target: Quindecim minuta?

source: Flying Hadmagk’s eyelid twitched, and he suddenly looked like he remembered something important.
target: Palpebra eius convulsit, et subito videbatur aliquid magni momenti meminisse.

source: He immediately cursed at his sailor, “Did you forget about our important deal at the docks?
target: Statim nautam maledixit: “Oblitus es nostri magni momenti pacti ad molas?

source: Bastard, is your brain filled with nothing but booze, women, and pride?”
target: Bastarde, an cerebrum tuum nihil nisi potione, mulieribus atque superbia impletum sit?

source: Cursing, Flying Haddock turned and walked out of the Carnival Bar.
target: Maledicens, Flying Haddock conversus est et ex Taberna Carnivalis egrediebatur.

source: His sailor, though dumbfounded, instinctively followed him.
target: Nauta eius, quamquam attonitus, instanter eum secutus est.

source: The captain is always right!
target: Capitane semper rectus est!

source: The Carnival Bar remained quiet as Lumian finished his Lanti Proof and stood up.
target: Taberna Carnivalis silentium servavit, dum Lumian Lanti Proof perfecit et surrexit.

source: With those crimson‐white fireballs still floating around him, he swept his gaze over the pirates once more.
target: Cum illis globulis ignium rubro‐albis adhuc circa eum volitantibus, circumspexit piratas.

source: Then he smiled, raised his right hand, brought his index and middle fingers to his lips, and blew softly.
target: Deinde risit, manum dexteram levavit, digitos index et medios ad labia sua adduxit, atque leniter sufflavit.

source: It was like he was blowing away the smoke from a gun after shooting everyone in the bar.
target: Erat quasi, fumo sclopeti, post omnes in taberna iaculatos evellere conaretur.

source: As the pirates’ eyes and expressions shifted, Lumian leisurely walked towards the door with his hands in his pockets.
target: Dum oculi et vultus piratarum mutabantur, Lumian lente ad ostium ambulavit, manibus in sinu suis positis.

source: One by one, the pirates instinctively moved out of his way.
target: Uno post alium, piratae instinctive se a via eius removerunt.

source: Some felt aggrieved, some ground their teeth, and others consoled themselves with thoughts like, It’s not fear; those fireballs are just too blinding!
target: Alii se offensos sentirent, alii dentes stringebant, et alii cogitationibus consolabantur: “Non timor; illa globula ignium nimis caecantia sunt!”

source: Lumian seemed utterly unafraid of being ambushed as he walked out of the Carnival Bar, almost like he was receiving their admiration and welcome.
target: Lumian videbatur omnino non timuisse insidiari, dum ex Taberna Carnivalis egrederetur, quasi eorum admirationem et beneficentiam acciperet.

source: Late at night, in an inconspicuous hotel room in Banamo Port.
target: Sero nocte, in cubiculo parvo in hospitio Portus Banamo.

source: Leaning back in his chair, Lumian said to Franca, “Disguise yourself and spread the word that an unknown adventurer has been provoking all the pirates, claiming they’re cowards with no real strength, and that he could crush any pirate’s head under his boot.”
target: Recumbens in sella sua, Lumian Francae dixit: “Te tege et nuntiā, quod adventor ignotus omnes piratas provocaverit, dicens eos ignavos esse sine vera virtute, et quod caput cuiusque piratae sub calce conterere possit.”

source: Franca’s mouth twitched slightly.
target: Os Francae leviter tremuit.

source: “Fishing again?
target: “Iterum piscare?

source: You’re quite the expert at this…
target: Es vere peritus in hoc…

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian subridens respondit.

source: “According to the information we’ve gathered, Admiral Deep Sea prefers to stay out of the public eye because of his sea monster bloodline.
target: Secundum informationes quas collegimus, Admiralis Deep Sea mavult extra oculos publicos remanere propter stirpem monstrorum maris.

source: Even if he comes to Banamo Port, he’ll likely stay on his flagship, the Newins.
target: Etiam si ad Portum Banamo venerit, verisimiliter in nave sua praecipua, Newins, permaneat.

source: If he wants women or food, someone will bring it to him.
target: Si mulieres aut cibum velit, aliquis id ei afferet.

source: “In this situation, we’ll have to risk sneaking onto the Newins.
target: “In hac re, oportet nobis in Newins silentio se introducere.”

source: It’s an alchemical ship from some ancient ruins, and we have no idea what traps or mechanisms it might have.
target: Navis alchemica est ex quibusdam antiquis ruinis, nec scimus quae insidias aut machinationes habeat.

source: Plus, there are bound to be many Beyonder pirates on board.
target: Praeterea, multi piratae Beyonder in nave esse certi sunt.

source: As a Hunter, we should avoid fighting on someone else’s turf.
target: Ut Venatores, pugnam in territorio alieno vitare debemus.

source: “I deliberately provoked the pirates in Banamo Port because I know no Pirate Admirals are here right now.
target: “Consulto piratas Portus Banamo provocavi, quia scio nullos Admirales Piratarum hic esse.

source: I have enough confidence to handle the other notable pirates.
target: Satis fiduciae habeo ad tractandum ceteros piratas notabiles.

source: They should soon figure this out too.
target: Mox id quoque perspici debent.

source: Expecting pirate crews to work together against me overestimates their trust in each other.
target: Exspectatio ut turmae piratarum adversus me simul operentur, fidem inter se nimis auget.

source: Who would they rather rob?
target: Quem potius rapinare malunt?

source: Jenna suddenly understood.
target: Jenna subito intellexit.

source: “If Admiral Deep Sea leaves the Newins and takes action himself, that would be the best outcome.
target: “Si Admiralis Deep Sea Newins discedat et ipse agere incipiat, optimum erit.

source: We would be fighting on our terms.
target: Nos in nostro more pugnabimus.

source: Even if he isn’t interested, his top men won’t miss the chance.
target: Etiam si non velit, milites eius superiores occasionem non amittent.

source: With Admiral Deep Sea as their backup, they won’t fear failure and will be more willing to challenge you.
target: Cum Admirali Deep Sea pro subsidio, non timebunt cladem, et libenter te provocabunt.

source: This will reduce the number of Beyonders on the Newins, giving us our chance.
target: Hoc numerum piratorum Beyonder in Newins diminuet, nobis occasionem praebens.

source: “Good psychological analysis,” Lumian teased.
target: “Bona psychologica analysis,” iocatus est Lumian.

source: Jenna shot him a look.
target: Jenna eum aspexit.

source: “A good actor needs to understand people’s minds.”
target: “Bonus actor mentes hominum intellegere debet.”

source: “And then perform for the ‘spectators’?” Lumian joked.
target: “Et deinde pro spectatoribus agere?” inquit Lumian iocose.

source: Anthony didn’t react.
target: Antonius non respondit.

source: Franca scoffed.
target: Franca irriduit.

source: “What if a Pirate King’s fleet arrives before the Newins?”
target: “Quid si classem Regis Piratarum ante Newins adveniat?”

source: Lumian spread his hands and said, “That’s why the adventurer is ‘unknown.
target: Lumian manibus expansis dixit: “Quare adventor ignotus est.

source: The benefit is that he can disappear without a trace.
target: Beneficium est quod sine vestigio evanescere possit.

source: Change his face and appearance, and we can execute another plan.”
target: Faciem et habitu mutato, alium consilium efficere possumus.

source: “A Conspirer is really an outright schemer…” Franca muttered.
target: “Coniurator vere est dolosus,” murmurat Franca.

source: “Alright, let’s do it.”
target: “Bene, faciamus.”

source: Lumian then discussed the possibility of using a large‐scale plague in Banamo Port, emphasizing the need to secretly distribute preventive medicine to the locals beforehand.
target: Lumian de possibilitate magnae plagae in Portu Banamo utendi disseruit, necessitatem celate medicamenta praeventionis in indigenis distribuendi extollens.

source: Franca was stunned.
target: Franca attonita fuit.

source: After a few seconds, she said, “You even thought of that…
target: Post paucis secundis, dixit: “Etiam id cogitasti…

source: How about we start a plague company?
target: “Quid, si societatem pestifera condamus?

source: Just kidding, there’s some plausibility in this, but in this day and age, there are no vaccines—uh, preventive medicine?”
target: “Modo iocor, aliqua probabilitas in hoc est, sed in his temporibus nullae sunt vaccina—immo, medicamenta praeventionis?”

source: “Normally, we wouldn’t have it, but we can turn to mysticism,” Lumian replied.
target: “Normaliter, id non habemus, sed ad mysticitatem confugere possumus,” respondit Lumian.

source: “The Apothecary path specializes in this.
target: “Via apothecaria hoc specialiter incumbit.

source: We just need to provide them with a number of infected individuals for observation, research, and experimentation.
target: Nobis solum opus est eos cum aliquot infectis hominibus ad observationem, inquisitionem, et experimentum praebere.

source: They should be able to create effective preventive or curative medicine.
target: Illi medicamenta praeventionis vel curativa efficax efficere debent.

source: We won’t have trouble finding an Apothecary.
target: Non habebimus difficultatem apothecarium invenire.

source: The Fool Pharmaceutical Company has plenty of them.
target: The Fool Pharmaceutical Company eos in copia habet.

source: Lumian knew from Miss Magician that The Fool Pharmaceutical Company had many ties to the Tarot Club.
target: Lumian ex Domina Magica scivit The Fool Pharmaceutical Company multas coniunctiones cum Tarot Club habere.

source: Jenna began to calculate.
target: Jenna coepit computare.

source: “A medicine with mystical effects would cost at least 100 verl d’or per bottle.
target: “Medicamentum cum effectibus mysticis saltem centum verl d’or pro lagena constabit.

source: There are probably over ten thousand non‐pirate residents in Banamo Port.
target: Verisimiliter plus quam decem milia incolarum non piratarum in Portu Banamo sunt.

source: We’d need to prepare at least a million verl d’or.
target: Saltem unum milionem verl d’or praeparare oportet.

source: We can’t expect the Apothecaries from The Fool Pharmaceutical Company to work for free or cover the material costs.
target: Exspectare non possumus Apothecarios The Fool Pharmaceutical Company gratis operari aut expensas materiales solvere.

source: One million verl d’or wasn’t a small sum.
target: Unum milionem verl d’or non erat parva summa.

source: Even a Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristic only cost around 200,000 verl d’or.
target: Etiam proprietas Sequence 5 Beyonder circiter ducenta milia verl d’or tantum constabat.

source: “A million verl d’or to become a demigod is a good deal,” Lumian suddenly laughed.
target: “Unum milionem verl d’or ad semideum fieri bonum pretium est,” subitamente risit Lumian.

source: “A million verl d’or is just an Admiral Deep Sea.
target: “Unum milionem verl d’or tantum est ut Admiralis Deep Sea.

source: Even if we can’t kill him, his top men are valuable too.”
target: Etiam si eum occidere non possimus, milites eius superiores quoque pretiosi sunt.

source: Franca sighed and replied, “You’re starting to sound a bit like Gehrman Sparrow.
target: Franca suspiravit et respondit: “Tu paulo similis Gehrman Sparrow sonare incipis.

source: But while Gehrman Sparrow treated pirates as his piggy bank, only targeting high‐bounty ones, you’re aiming to eradicate them completely!”
target: At dum Gehrman Sparrow piratas tamquam arcam pecuniae suas tractabat, petens solum eos qui magna praemia haberent, tu eos omnino exterminare intendis!

source: A plague like that would likely affect thousands, if not tens of thousands, of pirates.
target: Plaga talis verisimiliter milia, si non decem milia, piratarum afficiet.

source: Before Lumian could respond, Franca self‐mockingly laughed.
target: Antequam Lumian responderet, Franca se ipsam irridens risit.

source: “Poor Admiral Deep Sea. Just sitting on his flagship, doing nothing, and suddenly he’s our target.”
target: “Pauper Admiralis Deep Sea, iusto in nave sua praecipua sedens, nihil faciens, et subito meta nostra factus est!”

source: Lumian chuckled, and said with some realization, “Nothing to pity. A Hunter’s job is to create chaos and strife.
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Nil est miserandum; munus Venatoris est chaos et discordiam creare.

source: And your primary job as a Demoness is to bring catastrophe and affliction.
target: Et tuum munus principale ut Demonissa est calamitatem et afflictionem adferre.

source: It’s better to inflict these on pirates than innocent people.”
target: Melius est haec piratis quam in innocentes inferre.

source: Franca and Jenna fell silent for a moment.
target: Franca et Jenna paulisper silent.

source: Achoo!
target: Eruco!

source: Banamo Port, Mason, sitting at the docks with a bottle of rye beer, suddenly sneezed.
target: Mason, in Portu Banamo, sedens ad molas cum lagena cervisiae secalis, subito sternutavit.

source: He immediately thought of the messenger summoning ritual he had completed that afternoon and the unsettling messenger it had summoned, muttering to himself, “Could that sneeze be some kind of spirituality warning?
target: Statim recordatus est ritu nuntiandi, quem illo postmeridiano perfecerat, et de incommodo nuntio, quem evocatam habuerat, murmurans sibi: “Num haec sternutatio aliqua spiritualis monitione sit?

source: “Am I really going to be the protagonist of some occult event, the fool who makes a mistake and attracts an evil god or devil?
target: “Num vere ego futurus sim protagonistā alicuius occultī eventus, stultus qui errorem facit et deum malum aut daemonem attrahit?

source: “Did the ritual I performed bring some kind of catastrophe to Banamo Port?
target: “Num ritus quem perfeci aliquam calamitatem in Portum Banamo attulit?

source: “Have hidden dangers and problems started quietly spreading in the shadows?”
target: “Num pericula abscondita et quaestiones latentia in umbris quiete diffunduntur?”

source: Gulping down a large swig of beer, Mason tried to reassure himself that he was just scaring himself.
target: Magno sorbendo cervisiam, Mason se consolari conatus est, existimans se solum se ipsum terruisse.

source: From afternoon until now, there had been no signs of calamity or reports of strange phenomena!
target: A postmeridie usque ad nunc nullae erant notas calamitatis nec relationes de phaenomenis insolitis!

source: It was just a messenger summoning. It should be fine!
target: Erant tantum nuntii evocatio. Bene erit!
